name: Lyricist (Spellsinger Archetype)
body:
Lyricists are spellsingers who stucy music and its connection to spells. They practice their magic using spellbooks and scrolls on which they write their songs. They are just as capable of using their songs in combat, but might lack the showmanship of naturally gifted spellsingers.

Skill Ranks per Level

2 + Int modifier

Spellcasting

A lyricist’s spellcasting relies on Intelligence, rather than Charisma, and they don’t gain spells known. Instead, the lyricist gains spells per day as a wizard of his spellsinger level (plus additional spells for having a high Intelligence modifier). He keeps a songbook in which he can write the spells. This functions as a wizard’s spellbook, and the lyricist can prepare his spells after resting in the same way a wizard prepares spells each day.

A lyricist’s songbook begins with every 0-level spellsinger spell presented here (the GM may allow some spells to be traded for other spells from different sources), as well as three 1st-level spellsinger spells of the lyricist’s choice. The lyricist can also select a number of additional 1st-level spells equal to his Intelligence modifier to add to the songbook. At each new spellsinger level, he gains two new spells of any spell level or levels that he can cast (based on his new spellsinger level) for his songbook.

At any time, a lyricist can also add spells found in wizards’ spellbooks to his own; but only if those spells are on the spellsinger spell list (or he gains access to them in some other way). Similarly, wizards and other prepared spellcasters can copy spells from the lyricist if those spells can be found on their respective spell lists.

This alters the spellsinger’s spellcasting.

Songscroll (Ex)

At 1st level, a lyricist gains Scribe Scroll as a bonus feat. The scrolls a lyricist creates can be used by non-spellsingers with ranks in Perform (sing). This otherwise functions as casting a spell from a scroll with Use Magic Device.

This ability replaces the spellsinger’s arcane muse, but he can gain that ability back in place of any of his spellsongs beginning at 2nd level.

Spellsongs

Lyricists can prepare spellsongs—which are separate from their regularly prepared spells—within the same duration as they prepare their spellsinger spells for the day.

Lyricists can’t prepare the spellsong book variant spellsong, but they can still prepare spellsong research.

Lyricist Variant Spellsongs

Lyricists and spellsingers with the spellsong book variant spellsong can prepare the following variant spellsong.

Harmonize

When you prepare your spells for the day, you can select a number of allies up to your Intelligence or Charisma modifier (you choose). If those allies spend at least 10 minutes with you while you prepare, they become harmonized with you until the next time you prepare spells.

Harmonized allies who can see and hear you can cast your prepared spells of this slot’s level or lower, using your spell slots and their own actions. They must be adjacent to you or have access to their own focus or materials if those spells require such components.
